findings.text: The version check creates a gap for Node 14.17.0 through 14.x: the condition skips x64 fallback for versions >= 14.17.0 AND < 15.0.0, causing macOS ARM64 users to attempt downloading non-existent arm64 binaries for these versions (e.g., input '14.18.0' on darwin_arm64 will fail to download).
